introduction: Bharat Goradia connects event organisers, cultural associations and brands with Bollywood artists for celebrations, festivals and community events.
biography: Bharat works with organisers from the first conversation onwards: understanding the occasion, suggesting artists who suit it, and agreeing the arrangements together. This short biography will be replaced with Bharat's own approved story.

seo.description: Bharat Goradia arranges Bollywood artist appearances, live entertainment and cultural events. See photographs, videos and recognition, and get in touch.
